records.title: SupressNotFound under a mounted sub-router
records.flow: Request /api/ping; middleware must Match against canonical rctx.RoutePath (/ping), not r.URL.Path (/api/ping), using a throwaway context.
records.postconditions: A defined /ping route is found; no spurious 404; live rctx unmutated.

records.title: PageRoute under a mounted sub-router
records.preconditions: root.Mount("/admin", child); child uses PageRoute("/status", h)
records.flow: Request /admin/status; the match must compare against rctx.RoutePath (/status).
records.postconditions: PageRoute fires for the mounted path.

records.title: PathRewrite under a mounted sub-router
records.flow: Rewrite must update the canonical routing path so chi's subsequent walk (which reads rctx.RoutePath) observes the rewrite.
records.postconditions: chi routes the rewritten path, not the original.

records.title: RFC-correct request-header parsing (umbrella)
records.preconditions: Client sends Accept-Encoding: gzip;q=0 / Content-Type: text/plain; charset="utf-8" / padded or ported X-Forwarded-For
records.flow: Each parser tokenizes per its RFC (q-value honored, quoted params handled, whitespace trimmed) before deciding.
records.postconditions: q=0 suppresses compression; quoted charset matched; valid XFF entries accepted.

records.title: HTTP-method closed-set consistency (umbrella)
records.preconditions: A custom method is registered, or a request uses an unsupported method.
records.flow: methodMap, reverseMethodMap, and mALL are updated together; routeHTTP and the 405 Allow builder read a consistent set.
records.postconditions: Allow header lists exactly the registered methods; wildcard registration covers the new method.

records.title: Find mirrors live routing on a top-level route
records.flow: Find returns the pattern with the same context effects as a live walk.

records.title: Find mirrors live routing on a mounted route
actors: code calling Mux.Find against a mounted sub-router
records.flow: Find shifts RoutePath AND performs the wildcard-URLParam reset the live closure does.
records.postconditions: Returned pattern and resulting context match the live path exactly.

records.title: RoutePattern() for a route with a trailing wildcard
records.flow: replaceWildcards collapses only synthesized mount wildcards.
records.postconditions: Reported pattern preserves a legitimate trailing *.

records.title: walk() full-route reconstruction with an interior literal *
records.preconditions: A route whose pattern legitimately contains an interior * segment.
records.flow: The /*/ to / collapse must not erase a literal interior segment.
records.postconditions: The walked full route is faithful to the registered pattern.

records.title: Compressible content-type whitelist completeness
records.preconditions: A response with a content type in defaultCompressibleContentTypes vs one not in it.
records.flow: isCompressible decides eligibility by exact membership (plus configured wildcards).
records.postconditions: Only whitelisted (or wildcard-configured) types are compressed.

records.title: Compression writer does not over-declare Content-Encoding
records.preconditions: A request whose Accept-Encoding falsely selects an encoder (REQ-002 surface).
records.flow: WriteHeader/writer() couple so the declared Content-Encoding matches the bytes written.
records.postconditions: No Content-Encoding header on a body that was not actually compressed.

records.title: Param backtracking keeps Keys/Values aligned
actors: chi router walking a deep tree with mixed param/regexp/catch-all siblings
records.preconditions: A registration set that forces backtracking across sibling node types.
records.flow: findRoute unwinds candidate values without skewing Keys vs Values length.
records.postconditions: URLParam returns the correct value by index; no param misalignment.
